Prophecy: Works Tested by Fire on the Day
ProphecySummary: Paul says every man's work will be made manifest on the day, revealed by fire that tries its quality: work that abides receives a reward, work that burns brings loss, though the builder himself is saved yet so as by fire.
Fulfillment: Awaited. This testing day for believers' works has not yet occurred; it is distinct from the final judgment of the world in that the person tested is saved even when the work is lost.
